metadata.technology_specification: Touchscreen smartphone with OLED display and lithium-ion battery
metadata.technology_reasoning: Modern smartphones with OLED displays represent over 60% of premium and mid-range devices as of 2024, having become the industry standard due to superior contrast, power efficiency, and thin form factors.

Display Module (OLED).name: Glass
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Glass serves as the substrate providing structural support and optical clarity, universally used in rigid OLED displays.

Display Module (OLED).name: Indium
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Indium is a key component of ITO (indium tin oxide) transparent conductor, the industry standard in OLED displays.

Display Module (OLED).name: Acrylic
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Used in housing, bezels, and backing layers; multiple polymer options exist.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Lithium
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Primary energy storage element in lithium-ion chemistry, absolutely essential with no viable alternatives at commercial scale.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Cobalt
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Cathode material providing high energy density and stability, industry standard though LFP alternatives are emerging.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Nickel
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Cathode material enabling high energy density, commonly used in NMC and NCA chemistries.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Copper
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Essential electrical conductor for current collectors and internal wiring, universal across all battery designs.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Aluminum
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Used for casing and cathode current collectors, industry standard though some designs use steel casings.

Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).name: Graphite
Battery Pack (Lithium-ion).reasoning: Anode material critical for lithium intercalation, universal in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Copper
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Primary conductor material for PCB traces and interconnections, universally used due to excellent conductivity.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Silicon
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Semiconductor substrate used in integrated circuits mounted on PCBs, essential for electronic function.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Epoxy resins
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used as the matrix material for PCB laminates providing mechanical strength and electrical insulation.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Fiberglass
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Reinforcement material in PCB substrates to enhance mechanical properties and thermal stability.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Gold
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used in plating contacts and connectors for corrosion resistance and reliable conductivity, though alternatives exist.

Camera Module.name: Glass
Camera Module.reasoning: Used for camera lens elements providing optical clarity and hardness.

Camera Module.name: Silicon
Camera Module.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material used in image sensors to convert light into electrical signals.

Camera Module.name: Copper
Camera Module.reasoning: Used in sensor wiring and circuit interconnections due to excellent conductivity.

Camera Module.name: Aluminum
Camera Module.reasoning: Used in housing and structural components for lightweight strength; alternatives exist.

Chassis/Frame.name: Aluminum
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Widely used for smartphone chassis and frames due to lightweight and high strength; industry standard.

Chassis/Frame.name: Stainless steel
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Used in premium or reinforced frames for strength and corrosion resistance.

Chassis/Frame.name: Magnesium
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Sometimes used as lightweight metal alternative in premium phone frames; less common than aluminum.

Speakers.name: Copper
Speakers.reasoning: Used for voice coil wiring and electrical connections due to high conductivity.

Speakers.name: Neodymium
Speakers.reasoning: Primary rare earth magnet material in speaker magnets, providing strong magnetic fields essential for operation.

Speakers.name: Aluminum
Speakers.reasoning: Used in structural components and diaphragms for its lightweight and strength.

Vibration Motor.name: Copper
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Used for coil winding essential for electromagnetic operation.

Vibration Motor.name: Iron
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Used as core material to concentrate magnetic fields in voice coils.

Vibration Motor.name: Aluminum
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Used for housing and rotor components; alternatives exist but aluminum is common.

Vibration Motor.name: Neodymium
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Used in rare earth magnets within motors to generate magnetic fields for vibration.
